name: Adjust kinds, filters and looks
description: The adjust-everywhere part of Adjust/: AdjustKinds (GrayWeights, ImagingKind's Black & White and Invert compiled to a GPU tone program and its CPU twin, and ImagingFilter's five filters with their ranges), FilterRules (each filter over creative-core on a layer's padded bounds, mixed by a selection's coverage), LookPresets (LookPreset and the six BuiltInLooks) and AdjustCommands, the adjust.*, filter.* and look.* commands an app adds on an AdjustTarget, each edit one undo step. Photo (PhotoAdjust+Kernel: filters on the selected pixel layer inside the selection, B&W and Invert as adjustments and layer kinds), Library (LibraryLooks+Kernel: Black & White and looks on whole photos, filters unavailable) and Halo (HaloFilters+Kernel: a per-layer list drawn live and in the render) adopt them through their catalogs.
technology: Swift 6, CoreRaster, CoreRender and SuiteKernel, Linux and macOS
